title: Complete G20 source-refinement admission at ordinary BIT saving 0.003497804579519
body:
This closes the full-caller and ordinary-admission handoff from [PR5662](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5662), using Dugongue's exact [PR5657](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5657) source refinements. The resulting conditional ordinary BIT saving is **0.003497804579519**, an increase of **0.000009225052519 (about 0.264436%)** over [PR5653](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5653). This is a complete conditional component result, not a whole multiplication kappa claim.

The exact emitted local word is installed in all eighteen calls. The fresh global replay retains 11,166 independent originals, returns all 39 owned fields, binds all 56,547 paid queries to chronological source descriptors, and checks 446,604 events and 2,367 payload episodes. The explicit new frame-506 matcher contributes 5,472 coefficient terms to a positive finite fee. Both rational-series implementations pass fresh compiler-tail, stock, cover and five-level ordinary checks.

The proof also removes any fixed finite-parameter loss below this invoice's raw crossing: every strict ordinary saving below that crossing is attainable under the retained framework. The numeric certificate is within 1.31e-13 of the certified upper root bound. This does not assert global optimality or admit the crossing itself.

Evidence: [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e9f3375fc06f639285f4fbca44c3280831f84318/research/g20-refinement-admission/PROOF.md), [global result](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e9f3375fc06f639285f4fbca44c3280831f84318/research/g20-refinement-admission/GLOBAL-RESULT.json), [ordinary certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e9f3375fc06f639285f4fbca44c3280831f84318/research/g20-refinement-admission/ORDINARY-RESULT.json), [independent result](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e9f3375fc06f639285f4fbca44c3280831f84318/research/g20-refinement-admission/INDEPENDENT-RESULT.json), and [replay instructions](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e9f3375fc06f639285f4fbca44c3280831f84318/research/g20-refinement-admission/README.md).

Validation: registered Python 3.12 normal and optimized replays, exact committed-file checks, official package export and Git-free optimized replay. The normalizer, all-width native, ROW/compiler, owned-stock, precision/tape and analytic premises remain. The enormous uniform word and rounded multiplier are not executed. Full-history ancestry preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout. The newer [PR5665](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5665) proposes a stronger BIT word by late helper binding and reports no executed source replay; it is not included in this exact-word certificate. Hosted CI is separate; the known shared planner navigation failure has a pending fix in PR5659. Selected .00310045 is unchanged.

Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit Dugongue for the local construction, ai-nanachi and the complete retained G20 lineage for the controller and framework, and the prior authors listed in [NOTICE.md](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e9f3375fc06f639285f4fbca44c3280831f84318/research/g20-refinement-admission/NOTICE.md). This package supplies the full integration, strict finite margins and checks; it does not claim the source identities as new discoveries.
